Kforce has a client in Jacksonville, FL that is seeking a Junior Data Analyst.

Summary:
We are seeking a Junior Data Analyst to support an enterprise data documentation and discovery initiative. This role will focus on identifying, cataloging, and documenting data assets across multiple databases to improve data visibility, accuracy, and organizational alignment.
The Junior Data Analyst will work as part of a collaborative team of five, supporting documentation, validation, configuration, and testing efforts across a broad database environment.

Responsibilities:
 
  Assist in cataloging and documenting data assets across enterprise databases 
  Support data discovery, classification, and metadata documentation activities 
  Partner with team members to review database contents and validate data mappings 
  Participate in configuration and testing activities to help ensure accurate results 
  Document findings, data lineage, and observations using standard office productivity tools 
  Maintain clear, organized documentation to support internal data management initiatives 
  Collaborate with analysts, technical team members, and internal stakeholders 
  Follow established processes and contribute to continuous improvement efforts 
 
 
  To be considered for this position, candidates must have experience in a similar role, or they must possess significant knowledge, experience, and abilities to successfully perform the responsibilities listed 
  Relevant education and/or training will be considered a plus
